unification.c1: Here you can set the mode the unification will work in; options: 'full': uses the exact json base files without changes; 'replace': replaces instead of adds, when remove is available; 'no_add': doesn't add new items only replaces and removes originals, uses the same logic as 'replace'
unification.c2: This is a list of mod priorities used if mode is replace or no_add; uses alphabatical order if not provided
unification.c3: Here you can overwrite the mod chosen for a specific material if mode is replace or no_add; syntax: {material: mod}
unification.c4: Setting this to true, will disable the creation of new recipes and will only add recipes that have been removed (so it acts as a replacement of recipes)
unification.c5: If replace_recipes is set to true, this will still add recipes for the specified recipe types
unification.c6: Here recipe types can be configured to never add new recipes, in some cases these recipes can still exist if being replaced; is prioritized over recipe_types_to_keep
unification.c7: Here you can enable weither failed item replacements should be added as a new item instead, also affects the modes 'replace' and 'no_add' by allowing materials_types from remove to also be replaced again
unification.c8: Here you can enable weither the material_type check for mod specific materials should be disabled (e.g. for crushed_ore from create)
unification.c9: Here you can enable or disable weither gems textures should be replaced
unification.c10: Here you can enable or disable weither textures should be replaced at all; overwrites replace_gem_textures if false
unification.c11: Which resource loader to use for textures; options: 'lmr' - faster, but may not work; 'kubejs' - a lot slower, but definetly always works

ores.c1: Weither ores should be added at all
ores.c2: Weither the metal ores should drop itself
ores.c3: Weither the metal should be affected by fortune, disabled when dropping the ore itself
ores.c4: Weither the metal should be affected by silk touch, disabled when dropping the ore itself
ores.c5: Weither the gem ores should drop itself
ores.c6: Weither the gem should be affected by fortune, disabled when dropping the ore itself
ores.c7: Weither the gem should be affected by silk touch, disabled when dropping the ore itself
ores.c8: Here you can modify the ore drop dimension multiplier for the ores
